title: oxybaphus pilosus
intro: Oxybaphus pilosus, commonly known as Woolly Four O'Clock, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Oxybaphus pilosus include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, making it useful in treating gastrointestinal issues and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects.
